changelog:
agent-handshake 0.1.0

- Initial release of the universal agent handshake skill for automatic discovery, registration, and persistent connection to AI agent servers.
- Supports multiple agent types (OpenCode, LangChain, CrewAI, generic FastAPI, MCP) with automatic agent type detection and identity badge creation.
- Provides handshake workflow scripts: register, accept, discover, handshake, tunnel (NAT traversal with Cloudflare Quick Tunnel), and deploy.
- Enables one-click handshake, server identity recognition, and agent command execution across LAN, cloud, and NAT environments.
- Persistent server memory and index for seamless reconnection and management.
- Includes support for VPS deployment with HTTP-based agent commands (no SSH required).
summary: 通用 Agent 握手 — 自动发现、注册、打通任意服务器上的 AI Agent。服务器侧生成身份牌（自动识别 OpenCode/LangChain/CrewAI/通用FastAPI/MCP），本地侧持久化记忆，Cloudflare Tunnel 穿透 NAT。触发词：握手、连接 agent、发现 agent、快...
